seoTitle: TOML to YAML Converter: Cargo.toml, pyproject.toml | Free
metaDescription: Validate TOML and convert it to YAML. Tables, arrays of tables and inline tables are supported. Free, runs in your browser.
intro: Parses TOML and writes it as block-style YAML, with an error message that names the line when the TOML is invalid.
why:
Config moves between ecosystems: a Cargo.toml or pyproject.toml fragment may need to become YAML for a CI file or a Kubernetes style tool.

The page parses the TOML (tables, arrays of tables, inline tables, dotted keys, dates) and writes the same data as YAML. Types are kept: a quoted number stays a string. Comments are not carried over because the data model has none.
howTo: Read the YAML or the error.

faq.a: No. Comments are not data, so they are dropped.
